say:1:1013619001:2.text: Your acquaintance vanished suddenly. Is everything okay?
say:1:1013619001:2.source_cn: 你们的熟人突然消失了。没关系吗？

say:2:1013619002:1.text: Atalanta, the more important question is how you're even here.
say:2:1013619002:1.source_cn: 这位大人风格如此，倒是阿塔兰忒……

choice_prompt:3:1013619002.text: Atalanta, the more important question is how you're even here.
choice_prompt:3:1013619002.source_cn: 这位大人风格如此，倒是阿塔兰忒……

say:4:1013619003:1.text: Ah, after returning to Holistone, Valen went to report to the general.
say:4:1013619003:1.source_cn: 啊，返回圣石镇后，维伦就去汇报了。
say:4:1013619003:1.male: Ah, after returning to Holistone, Valen went to report to the general.
say:4:1013619003:1.female: Ah, after returning to Holistone, Valen went to report to the general.

say:5:1013619004:1.text: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.
say:5:1013619004:1.source_cn: 他也是太小看我了，区区几个圣石镇民兵，怎么可能看得住我？
say:5:1013619004:1.male: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.
say:5:1013619004:1.female: And he underestimated me. It's laughable that he thinks a few militiamen from Holistone could possibly keep a watch on me.

say:7:1013619005:1.text: Come on, it was you guys who insisted on making things tough for me in the first place.
say:7:1013619005:1.source_cn: 话不能这么说，明明是你们几个硬要跟我为难的嘛。

say:8:1013619006:1.text: Additionally, my role as your guide isn't over yet. I still have to escort you to the Sun Temple.
say:8:1013619006:1.source_cn: 而且，我这个向导的工作明明还没结束。我得带着你们去日神...

say:10:1013619007:2.text: You're willing to lead us to the Sun Temple all of a sudden? Last time, you even used force to stop Temesia!
say:10:1013619007:2.source_cn: 忽然就肯带我们去日神殿？上次，你为了阻挠特弥希娅，甚至...

say:11:1013619008:1.text: Because Temesia packs quite a punch, and I didn't want to get hit again, alright?
say:11:1013619008:1.source_cn: 就当是特弥希娅打人太痛，我不想再挨打了，行了吧？

say:12:1013619009:1.text: Even though I'm a suspect in the theft of the Faith Stone, I've been with you guys all this time, and I haven't done anything to hurt you.
say:12:1013619009:1.source_cn: 即使我是圣石失窃的嫌疑人，但我就在你们眼皮底下行动，你...

say:13:1013619010:1.text: I already saved Temesia once—who's to say it can't happen again?
say:13:1013619010:1.source_cn: 我既然救过你一次——我就不信，救不了第二次。

say:15:1013619011:1.text: So, let me tag along with you. And what about you, my stubborn knight, what do you think?
say:15:1013619011:1.source_cn: 所以，就让我跟着你们吧。某位不听劝的圣骑士，你怎么说？

say:16:1013619012:2.text: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.
say:16:1013619012:2.male: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.
say:16:1013619012:2.female: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.

choice_prompt:17:1013619012.male: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.
choice_prompt:17:1013619012.female: ...I will leave it up to <style="stress"><player_name></style> to decide.

say:20:1013619014:2.text: When I first became a knight, I was weak. After a battle with a monster that left me severely injured, I fell into a coma.
say:20:1013619014:2.source_cn: 我刚成为骑士时，还很弱小。一次被派去与魔物战斗后，身受...
say:20:1013619014:2.male: When I first became a knight, I was weak. After a battle with a monster that left me severely injured, I fell into a coma.
say:20:1013619014:2.female: When I first became a knight, I was weak. After a battle with a monster that left me severely injured, I fell into a coma.

say:21:1013619015:1.text: When I woke up, Atalanta was there. I then found out that she went through a lot to find a magical potion that saved me.
say:21:1013619015:1.source_cn: 醒来时，就看到阿塔兰忒在我床前。我才知道，是她历尽辛苦...
say:21:1013619015:1.male: When I woke up, Atalanta was there. I then found out that she went through a lot to find a magical potion that saved me.
say:21:1013619015:1.female: When I woke up, Atalanta was there. I then found out that she went through a lot to find a magical potion that saved me.

say:22:1013619016:1.text: ...And then after I recovered, my first task was to chase the suspect of the Faith Stone theft.
say:22:1013619016:1.source_cn: ……命运弄人。我痊愈后的第一个任务，就是追捕盗窃圣石的疑犯。
say:22:1013619016:1.male: ...And then after I recovered, my first task was to chase the suspect of the Faith Stone theft.
say:22:1013619016:1.female: ...And then after I recovered, my first task was to chase the suspect of the Faith Stone theft.

say:23:1013619017:1.text: Why bring up these old tales out of the blue?
say:23:1013619017:1.source_cn: 为什么突然开始说这些陈年旧事？

say:24:1013619018:2.text: Just pondering—for someone like me, unable to let go of personal feelings... becoming a sinner is inevitable.
say:24:1013619018:2.source_cn: 没什么。只是在想，我这样无法舍弃私情的人……会成为罪人...

say:25:1013619019:1.text: I shouldn't have let personal feelings interfere, going against the goddess' will...
say:25:1013619019:1.source_cn: 我本不该顾念私情，违背女神的旨意……

say:26:1013619020:1.text: Is the goddess the only reason worth living for to you?
say:26:1013619020:1.source_cn: 只有女神，才值得你活着吗？

say:28:1013619021:1.text: I'm a bit confused about your history and relationship...
say:28:1013619021:1.source_cn: 我有点搞不清楚你们俩的过去和关系了……

say:29:1013619022:1.text: Please allow us to have another private conversation...
say:29:1013619022:1.source_cn: 诸位，请允许我们再私下交谈一番……
